# coolify_s3_storages (Data Source)

Lists every S3 storage of the token's team (no credentials).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coolify_s3_storages" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `s3_storages` (Attributes List) All S3 storages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3_storages))

<a id="nestedatt--s3_storages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `s3_storages`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Bucket.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint.
- `is_usable` (Boolean) Connectivity validated.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `uuid` (String) UUID.
